decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical FAT directory entry structure and attribute masks.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
dossym.inc and smdossym.inc include dirent.inc; COMMAND tdata.asm includes it directly.
DOS dir2.asm uses directory entry fields including dir_attr, dir_time and dir_first.
The previously compared DIR2 contribution matches all 1413 target MSDOS.SYS bytes (review 054); the FAT module matches all 984 bytes (review 065).
limitations: These selected-build comparisons support the field definitions exercised by the compared code, not all declarations or build configurations. Final linking and complete core file identity remain unverified.
